title: Making private records with Lee Collins
summary: He says he made records with Lee Collins, Tee Paul and Joe Reni, privately in a room rather than for the market, and never with other bands.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Ask him, did he ever make any records?

Did Manuel ever make any records? I can't remember. I'm really much of it. No, you, you. It was when I went to Edwin Hall in Lee College. But we didn't make them for ourselves. And everybody gets a blank and set up in a room. And that's how they go. It was good too. If we didn't put them out on the market, nobody would make any records.
Ask him who was in the band.

Who was always in the band then? Lee Collins, Tee Paul, Joe Reni, and myself. And I don't know. Let me see. Let me see what I saw. I'm going to... Who's George Washington ever had? Yeah. I'd love to have those records. You didn't know him, eh, George. He wasn't much taller than me. No, he wasn't. Then once we had a band, I don't know what the name was. George Washington, Tee Paul, Johnny, myself, the wrestler Don, and Joe Reni. All of us. All of us. All of us in the band was short. I was the smallest one in the band. Yeah. Yeah, that's right. He said he got about a year, too. I didn't know what the name was about, and we just got together, you know. And it stuck like that, you know.
Ask him did he make any records.

So did you make any records? No, just like what I told you, you know. We used to buy them Blanc records. Anybody else? Yeah, and set up in a room like this, you know, and we played, touched it, you know. It just sounds good. But we know they put it out on the market, you know.
Ask him any other band he made records with.
So did you make records with any other band? Yeah, that was, uh, that was all Lee Collins. No, he said with any other band did you make any records? Oh, no, no, never did.
Ask him did Buddy ever make any records?
